Down to the register.

The UNO controller is written in AVR assembly. Flash tables select colors; PORTB drives the pins.

; write LED bits, preserve buzzer
set_color:
  in   scratch, PORTB
  andi scratch, low(~LED_MASK)
  or   scratch, temp
  out  PORTB, scratch
  ret

PORTB / LED bit positions

PB1 → D9 / RPB2 → D10 / GPB3 → D11 / B

Yellow: red + green

PB4 belongs to the buzzer. The LED mask preserves its current value.

ATmega328P · 16 MHzArduino C reference included in the repository

The ESP32 logs the MQTT command state. The UNO does not send LED feedback, and local button presses are not reported to the cloud.
